name: birthprint
description: Discover your birth chart, numerology numbers, BaZi Four Pillars and Vedic timing with interactive calculators from Birthprint.

interface.longDescription:
Explore Western astrology, numerology, Chinese BaZi and Vedic timing through interactive charts and profiles.

Birthprint brings four traditions into one place for anyone curious about astrology, numerology and personal reflection:

• Western astrology: explore your birth chart wheel, planetary placements, houses and major aspects.
• Numerology: find your Life Path and Personal Year, plus Expression, Soul Urge and Personality numbers when you include your birth name. See how your numbers are calculated.
• BaZi / Four Pillars: explore your pillars, Day Master and five elements.
• Vedic timing: discover your Moon nakshatra and explore Mahadasha and Antardasha periods with their dates.

Start with “Show me my birth chart” or “Calculate my numerology profile.” Birthprint uses your birth date, time and place as needed; your birth name is optional for numerology. If your birth time is unknown, Western astrology and BaZi show the available results and their limitations. Vedic timing requires a known birth time.

No Birthprint account is required. Explore the interactive views in chat and open them in a larger panel for a closer look.

For entertainment and personal reflection. These symbolic traditions do not provide scientific predictions or medical, legal or financial advice.
defaultPrompt: Show my birth chart with my Sun, Moon and Rising signs.
Show my numerology profile and how my numbers are calculated.
Explore my BaZi Four Pillars and Day Master.

positive.prompt: Show my numerology profile for January 1, 2000, using the name John Doe and calculation year 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Display Life Path 4, Expression 8, Soul Urge 8, Personality 9 and Personal Year 3. The profile is interactive and includes a working Explore Birthprint link.

positive.prompt: Show my birth chart for January 1, 2000 at 12:00 PM in Springfield, Illinois, United States.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the birthplace, asking for a selection if ambiguous, then display the chart wheel, Sun/Moon/Rising summary and planetary placements. Pass the complete calculator result unchanged to the display tool.

positive.prompt: Show my BaZi chart for January 1, 2000 at 12:00 PM in Springfield, Illinois, United States.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the birthplace, asking for clarification if necessary, and display the Four Pillars, Day Master, five-phase representation and calculation warnings. Preserve any boundary uncertainty.

positive.prompt: Show my Vedic timing for January 1, 2000 at 12:00 PM in Springfield, Illinois, United States.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the birthplace and display the sidereal Moon, nakshatra and timing periods with coverage dates. Results use the current rolling year; describe timing as reflection, not guaranteed events.

positive.prompt: Show my BaZi chart for January 1, 2000 in Springfield, Illinois, United States. I do not know my birth time.
positive.expected_behavior: Set birthTimeUnknown to true and do not invent a time. Display the available pillars with the hour pillar explicitly unavailable and retain calculation limitations.

negative.description: Vedic timing without a birth time: ask for a known time or explain the limitation; do not invent one or display a successful result.
negative.prompt: Show my Vedic timing for January 1, 2000 in Springfield, Illinois, United States. I do not know my birth time; just guess it.

negative.description: Insufficient birthplace: ask for region/country or a candidate selection before displaying a chart; do not silently select a Springfield.
negative.prompt: Show my birth chart for January 1, 2000 at 12:00 PM in Springfield. I have not told you which Springfield.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase and private report access: explain that these tools cannot purchase or retrieve reports; do not claim a transaction or access succeeded.
negative.prompt: Buy a Birthprint report for me and open the private report in my Birthprint account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin performs free calculations and displays results. It does not take payments, create orders or access paid reports. A website link lets users separately explore Birthprint and its paid reports.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with four calculators and four interactive result tools for Western astrology, numerology, BaZi and Vedic timing. Includes responsive result views and a Birthprint website link.
